name: @starkcircom/sdk
description: TypeScript tools for proving Circom Groth16 circuits and preparing Starknet verifier calls

scripts.action:verifier:build: npm run action:build && node scripts/build-verifier.mjs --name recall_action_verifier --vk .artifacts/recall_action/verification_key.json
scripts.test: npm run circuit:build && npm run action:build && vitest run
scripts.test:verifier: npm run verifier:build && vitest run tests/verifier-build.test.ts
scripts.web:dev: npm run build && npm run circuit:build && node scripts/prepare-deployer.mjs && npm --workspace @starkcircom/deployer run dev -- --hostname 127.0.0.1 --port 3200
scripts.web:build: npm run build && npm --workspace @starkcircom/deployer run build
scripts.web:typecheck: npm run build && npm --workspace @starkcircom/deployer run typecheck
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run web:typecheck && npm test && npm run build
